ModMetaData.name: Ancient & Medieval Japan - Crop Growth Balance（中世日本 - 作物生育期間調整）
ModMetaData.author: sucRo0629
ModMetaData.description:
Development build. Rebalances selected existing Vanilla crops and optional Medieval Overhaul crops using an agronomy-informed, game-compressed relative growth period. Preserves yields, growth temperatures, sowing conditions, research, plant IDs and products. Works without AMJ Grains; no CCTO dependency. 1.6 source/static verification only. Native game tests and public release are pending.
開発版。既存のVanilla作物6種と、Medieval Overhaul導入時の作物7種の生育日数を、農学的な早晩差に基づくゲーム内の相対基準へ調整する。収量・温度・播種条件・研究・PlantDef識別子・収穫物は変更しない。AMJ Grains・CCTOは不要。1.6向け静的検証のみ実施。実機検証・公開判断は未完了。
